name: Buy potato seed, compost, and a vial for A New Leaf

evidence.note: Rounded planning allowance for a first potato contract and three perfect crops plus the potion. Buy garden tools separately if needed.

name: Buy an adamant scimitar and food for the chefs and farmers

evidence.note: Uses the observed 1,436 GP scimitar and 88 GP cooked lobster guide figures plus a small allowance.

name: Accept a potato Farming contract

evidence.note: The forecast follows the Easy potato assignment. The NPC selects the crop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Jane assigns potatoes on an Easy contract.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Complete the actual assigned crop and turn it in. This replay represents the potato assignment.

name: Plant potatoes for the Farming contract

evidence.note: Clear an allotment and sow three potato seeds.

name: Harvest mature contract potatoes

evidence.note: Credit one picked potato and its XP. The contract records a successful harvest.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Pick potatoes from your mature Farming Guild allotment.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Treat a diseased crop or plant another batch if necessary.

name: Report the completed contract to Guildmaster Jane

evidence.note: Report the first harvest and receive an Easy seed pack.

name: Find a communication cabbage

evidence.note: Pick at the designated field. Keep two ordinary cabbages for the potion errands.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Obtain a communication cabbage and two normal cabbages.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep picking at the Hosidius field.

name: Eat the communication cabbage

evidence.note: Start the quest from the cabbage conversation.

name: Speak with Dishop Dennis

evidence.note: Discuss the work for the Church of Brassica.

name: Ask Dennis about making the stew

evidence.note: Receive the crop seeds and the Prayer to Brassica.

name: Plant the three crops for Dennis

evidence.note: Clear the two allotments and flower patch. Compost and plant cabbage, potato and rosemary in their own patches.

name: Use the prayer and harvest the perfect crops

evidence.note: Read the single-use prayer after all three crops have been planted, then harvest the three quest ingredients.

name: Take four empty bowls from the farmhouse crates

evidence.note: The crates supply one bowl per recipient.

name: Cook and portion four bowls of perfect cabbage stew

evidence.note: Use the perfect vegetables and rosemary in Dennis’s pot. Confirm the recipients with Dennis and fill four bowls.

name: Deliver stew to Guildmaster Jane

evidence.note: Deliver one prepared bowl to this recipient.

name: Deliver stew to the Farming Guild Sergeant

evidence.note: Deliver one prepared bowl to this recipient.

name: Deliver stew to Mary

evidence.note: Deliver one prepared bowl to this recipient.

name: Deliver stew to Konar

evidence.note: Deliver one prepared bowl to this recipient.

name: Report the four stew deliveries

evidence.note: Tell Dennis that all four recipients were served.

name: Give Dennis a cabbage for the potion research

evidence.note: Give a regular cabbage and obtain the referral to Allanna.

name: Get Allanna’s cabbage potion book

evidence.note: Ask Allanna for the recipe book after completing at least one Farming Guild contract.

name: Read the recipe and make cabbage water

evidence.note: Use the remaining regular cabbage with a vial of water after reading the book.

name: Ask Dennis to bless the potion compost

evidence.note: Use a bucket of regular compost. Supercompost and ultracompost are outside this potion recipe.

name: Make the Brassican sentience potion

evidence.note: Combine the blessed compost and cabbage water.

name: Give Dennis the potion and collect the spies

evidence.note: Finish the potion conversation and accept all five sprout spies and the return seed.

name: Place a sprout spy at the White Knights’ Castle range

evidence.note: Use one sprout spy on this appliance.

name: Place a sprout spy at the Hosidius mess-hall oven

evidence.note: Use one sprout spy on this appliance.

name: Place a sprout spy at the upstairs Grand Tree cooker

evidence.note: Use one sprout spy on this appliance.

name: Place a sprout spy at the cooking range in Sarah’s house

evidence.note: Use one sprout spy on this appliance.

name: Place a sprout spy at the Al Kharid kebab-shop range

evidence.note: Use one sprout spy on this appliance.

name: Report all five sprout spy placements

evidence.note: Tell Dennis that all five spies have been planted.

name: Ask Dennis to enter the chefs and farmers arena

evidence.note: Both Dennis assignments must be reported. The dialogue transfers the player into the instance.

name: Defeat the five chefs and farmers

evidence.note: Defeat the Gardener of Armadyl, Bandit Cactus Cultivator, Fermenter of Chaos, Sir Loin and Goblin Meat Tenderiser. Use melee protection if available. Food use is a planning reserve.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat all five opponents in one visit and return to Dennis.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restock and retry the encounter. Leaving the arena resets the enemies.

name: Report the victory to Dishop Dennis

evidence.note: Award two quest points from the client journal, the three fixed XP rewards, and the combat lamp. Enable the Farming Guild benefits.

name: Buy a rune scimitar, food and a Prayer potion for Rag and Bone Man III

evidence.note: Rounded forecast based on 14.7k GP for the rune scimitar, 88 GP per cooked lobster and 8,283 GP for the potion.

name: Ask the Odd Old Man about his collection

evidence.note: Start the third quest at the house north of the Digsite.

name: Read the monster list on the wall

evidence.note: The list unlocks the qualifying kills. This route uses the Lumbridge cow and chicken.

name: Kill a cow for the Odd Old Man’s list

evidence.note: Defeat one cow after reading the list. Keep the quest drop if one appears.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The cow kill advances the quest list.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Finish a cow kill at the pen and check for the quest prompt.

name: Kill a chicken for the Odd Old Man’s list

evidence.note: Defeat one chicken after reading the list. Keep the quest drop if one appears.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The chicken kill advances the quest list.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Finish a chicken kill and check for the quest prompt.

name: Return to the Odd Old Man and enter the dream

evidence.note: The quest script kills and transfers the player to its void. This is a quest progression cutscene.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Return after both listed kills and arrive in the quest void.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the wall list and finish the missing qualifying kill, then return.

name: Find Romeo in the void

evidence.note: Speak to Death if prompted on the repeated pass. Locate Romeo and ask him to take you to the altered island.

name: Speak with the Gielinor Guide

evidence.note: Finish the opening lesson dialogue and walk to the Survival Expert.

name: Finish the bare-handed fishing lesson

evidence.note: Speak to the Survival Expert and catch the scripted fish by hand to reach King Roald.

name: Rescue and speak to King Roald

evidence.note: Defeat the Lost Souls. Speak to the king to continue to the archmage’s chamber.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Lost Souls and advance through Roald’s dialogue.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Defeat any remaining Lost Souls before speaking to him.

name: Make Sedridor’s bed and return to him

evidence.note: Complete the archmage’s conversation, make his bed and speak again to enter the rift.

name: Let the rift restart the dream

evidence.note: Allow the planned dream encounter to send you back to the void. This does not use ordinary death travel.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The scripted encounter restarts the dream at the next pass.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Let the encounter finish and follow the return dialogue.

name: Find Romeo in the void

evidence.note: Speak to Death if prompted on the repeated pass. Locate Romeo and ask him to take you to the altered island.

name: Speak with the Gielinor Guide

evidence.note: Finish the opening lesson dialogue and walk to the Survival Expert.

name: Finish the bare-handed fishing lesson

evidence.note: Speak to the Survival Expert and catch the scripted fish by hand to reach King Roald.

name: Rescue and speak to King Roald

evidence.note: Defeat the Lost Souls. Speak to the king to continue to the archmage’s chamber.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Lost Souls and advance through Roald’s dialogue.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Defeat any remaining Lost Souls before speaking to him.

name: Ask Traiborn about changing the dream

evidence.note: Speak to Wizard Traiborn during the second pass before finishing Sedridor’s task.

name: Make Sedridor’s bed and return to him

evidence.note: Complete the archmage’s conversation, make his bed and speak again to enter the rift.

name: Let the rift restart the dream

evidence.note: Allow the planned dream encounter to send you back to the void. This does not use ordinary death travel.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The scripted encounter restarts the dream at the next pass.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Let the encounter finish and follow the return dialogue.

name: Find Romeo for the third pass

evidence.note: Use Romeo to enter the altered tutorial again.

name: Take the Gielinor Guide’s shortcut to Roald

evidence.note: The Guide now skips the Survival Expert and sends you directly to King Roald.

name: Defeat the Lost Souls and leave without speaking to Roald

evidence.note: After the rescue, head west and south to Traiborn. Speaking to Roald would follow the earlier loop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Lost Souls and keep the alternate route open by leaving Roald alone.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Finish the remaining Lost Souls and seek Traiborn.

name: Find Traiborn west and south of Roald

evidence.note: Speak to Traiborn and follow his directions back to the archmage.

name: Defeat the archmage and pick up his staff

evidence.note: Speak to the archmage, win the dream fight and take the dropped staff.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the archmage and take the staff before leaving.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue the fight, then pick up the staff.

name: Return to Traiborn and enter Tolna’s rift

evidence.note: Take the staff to Traiborn. He transfers you to the rift.

name: Defeat Tolna’s creatures with the archmage’s staff

evidence.note: Equip the staff for this pass and defeat the creatures before speaking to Tolna.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All of the creatures are defeated and Tolna can be spoken to.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Equip the staff and defeat the remaining creatures.

name: Speak to Tolna and leap into the pit

evidence.note: Tolna points you to the pit. Take the leap into the asylum.

name: Ask the strange creature about the waystones

evidence.note: Learn to break the four waystones before proceeding deeper.

name: Take the key and earmuffs from the desk

evidence.note: Search the entrance desk before opening the passage east.

name: Defeat the Ancient Banshee while wearing earmuffs

evidence.note: Wear the earmuffs. Reactivate Protect from Melee after the banshee disables it. Lobsters are an estimated reserve.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Ancient Banshee and reach its waystone.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check your earmuffs and protect from melee again after a scream.

name: Break the banshee wing waystone

evidence.note: Destroy the waystone after defeating its guard.

name: Read the book in the southern desk

evidence.note: Record the combination before operating the mechanism.

name: Enter the lock combination and break the waystone

evidence.note: Use the combination 3118 from the book and break the exposed stone.

name: Cross the asylum shadow maze

evidence.note: Watch the moving shadows, use the centre gaps and work around the southern shadow.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Reach the waystone on the far side of the maze.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Return to the safe openings and retry the crossing.

name: Break the shadow maze waystone and return

evidence.note: Break the far waystone and use a shadow to return to the maze entrance.

name: Break the northern asylum waystone

evidence.note: Break the remaining unguarded waystone in the north wing.

name: Enter the Skeletal Horror arena

evidence.note: With all four waystones destroyed, descend and speak to the Odd Old Man.

name: Defeat the Skeletal Horror

evidence.note: Use melee protection against melee attacks. Prioritize shadow rifts and crawling hands, and heal projectile damage. Food and Prayer potion consumption are forecast reserves.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Skeletal Horror and return to the Odd Old Man conversation.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use the regular death recovery if needed, restock and retry the final fight.

name: Finish speaking to the Odd Old Man

evidence.note: Receive three quest points and the separate Prayer and Slayer lamps.

name: Claim the heavy bonesack from the Odd Old Man

evidence.note: Talk to the Odd Old Man after the quest. This is the initial claim and its single item award.
